Finding the Light#002.src: ...ah. {u}. So you are needed here too, then?
Finding the Light#002.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#003.src: I am... TRYING... To awaken the Guardian of the Forest to receive its guidance, but it refuses to budge! Even the voice of Orphion provides no reaction.
Finding the Light#003.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#004.src: I beg once more of you, awaken! Us two... Us two seek your wisdom!
Finding the Light#004.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#005.src: I present you Orphion's barest light- Please, respond!
Finding the Light#005.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#006.src: Urgh... See? Nothing is happening. I'm at a loss of what to do. Maybe you can affect some change, considering what you've done before.
Finding the Light#006.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#007.src: My pulse, it is time. I shall shine my light upon the roots of the Guardian. You and she must learn now.

Finding the Light#008.src: Read the inscription at the bottom of the big tree.

Finding the Light#009.src: An inscription! That wasn't there before! It was... That was completely instant. How did you even...?
Finding the Light#009.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#010.src: But, still! I knew I could be useful, let me translate this for you! As a stranger to Gavel you wouldn't know High Gavellian...
Finding the Light#010.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#011.src: It says... Secrets uncovered in the oldest of libraries in {p}.
Finding the Light#011.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#012.src: ...of course. A place that Elves aren't allowed, but humans are. {u}, you'll have to find this library on your own, it seems.
Finding the Light#012.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#013.src: Find the Church Library in the city of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Finding the Light#014.src: Find a way up to the church bell at the top of the church.

Finding the Light#015.src: Explore the secret library and find a way to wake up the tree.

Finding the Light#017.src: Do you reject the light of Orphion? Waken, please!
Finding the Light#017.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#018.src: Urgh... {u}, please tell me you were able to make some progress. The Guardian still refuses... To... WAKE!
Finding the Light#018.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#019.src: What is this? A spell scroll- Of the Waking Forest?! In {p}, of all places? Where it would have been... Impossible for me to go...
Finding the Light#019.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#020.src: So I am Orphion's chosen, yet I would not have been able to do what was asked of me. That... No, I can't dwell on that, let me see the scroll.
Finding the Light#020.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#021.src: ...hm. It says, The seeker must rest these words upon those of the Guardian.
Finding the Light#021.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#022.src: I suppose that means you need to place it by the inscription. So yet another task that you must finish...
Finding the Light#022.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#023.src: ...go on, then, do it. I'm just needed here to be a translator for you thusfar, it seems.
Finding the Light#023.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#024.src: Use the spell on the inscription under the tree.

Finding the Light#025.src: Let me go ahead and read this, too. This will be tedious, I fear...
Finding the Light#025.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#026.src: It says... Awakening the Guardian of the Forest requires more than just magic. The home of the elves will house the answers and revelations...?
Finding the Light#026.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#027.src: That... This is finally my time! I still have a hand in this!! Finally, I can do something more than just holding stasis here!
Finding the Light#027.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#028.src: Listen, {u}. Achara... This is my time. I can finally help you more directly. I know the elders of {p}- They're sure to have answers!
Finding the Light#028.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#029.src: You truly have been helpful, even through my own worries. I must thank you, but you can relax now! I will be the one this time!
Finding the Light#029.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#030.src: You can continue doing...whatever else it is you need doing. I have seen you helping in various places- Concern yourself with those for now. I can handle this.
Finding the Light#030.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#031.src: Pursue her, my pulse. She must take dire action- Alone, her light shall illuminate nothing. You must provide her direction.

Finding the Light#032.src: Enter the portal Lari left behind

Finding the Light#033.src: Go to the hut Lari entered.

Finding the Light#034.src: W-What? You- Why did you follow me? I can handle this! I can finally be useful again! Do you...not trust me?
Finding the Light#034.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#035.src: Please, just respect my wishes! If I need your help, I'll go find you- For now, just leave! You don't need to worry about this!
Finding the Light#035.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#036.src: Find a way to sneak into the hut.

Finding the Light#037.src: ...if this human has truly done what you have said, then why do you spurn their aid? It is unlike you.
Finding the Light#037.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#038.src: I know, I know. I just am in disbelief. They've been contacted by Orphion himself, allowed into the Taproot, they have a symbol of Orphion's blessing!!
Finding the Light#038.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#039.src: They just...walked up, after a thousand years of my putting my entire life into trying to save this province, and do everything I couldn't, in the span of weeks at most!
Finding the Light#039.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#040.src: Do you understand how infuriating this is? Can you comprehend such a thing, not having been in my position yourself?
Finding the Light#040.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#041.src: No. I cannot understand. But I also cannot understand how you are not grateful for this aid.
Finding the Light#041.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#042.src: I know I should be! It's all I've been able to think about. I should be ecstatic! The light will be saved, it should be everything I've dreamed of...
Finding the Light#042.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#043.src: But it makes me feel like a complete failure. Like everything I have done has been for naught, that I have somehow been doing everything wrong!
Finding the Light#043.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#044.src: I know I have made mistakes. Dullahan would still be... Still be himself, if I had taken faster action, but I can't have done nothing right. I can't accept that.
Finding the Light#044.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#045.src: This is my chance to prove I can still be useful- that Orphion choosing me wasn't a fluke! Please, the inscription said you would know where to go!
Finding the Light#045.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#047.src: ...even after a millennium, there is so very much for us all to learn. Fine then.
Finding the Light#047.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#048.src: But promise me to accept the aid you receive. This opportunity cannot be wasted, Lari.
Finding the Light#048.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#049.src: ...I have to do at least one thing right. I can't just keep up this holding pattern. I'll do whatever is necessary!
Finding the Light#049.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#050.src: You must seek the Canned Abis plant, then. It rests within a cavern shaded by giant fern leaves.
Finding the Light#050.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#051.src: Thank you. I can finally do what I was meant to do! I won't let anything stop me this time!!
Finding the Light#051.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#052.src: ...Human, I can see you. Consider yourself lucky that she did not. Come talk to me.
Finding the Light#052.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#054.src: So you are Orphion's new chosen, then. It is both surprising and not- Humans have an interesting reputation.
Finding the Light#054.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#055.src: Often said as being able to get anything done, without limits, be it completing impossible tasks or breaking moral tenets.
Finding the Light#055.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#056.src: In this instance, however, you've both to do. Orphion has commanded it, has he not? And so you must, and for that I apologize.
Finding the Light#056.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#057.src: I have seen Lari's work- And she has done this land a priceless service. Alone, she has kept the Decay from creeping south, and thus the Guardian remains with us.
Finding the Light#057.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#058.src: However, her own morals prevent the situation from progressing. She cannot kill- And the source must be exterminated for light to once again fill the land.
Finding the Light#058.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#059.src: Orphion's circumstances are dire- And so you must come to understand something. He is above us, in terms of morals. Such concepts do not apply to him.
Finding the Light#059.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#060.src: As the embodiment of Light itself, he has no sense of morals- Merely survival and stasis. What he asks of us, many will balk at.
Finding the Light#060.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#061.src: It is a matter where morals must be set aside... And such a thing is one that Lari cannot abide by, for she has stubbornly clung to them for a thousand years.
Finding the Light#061.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#062.src: To break them... I will admit, I believe there to be some other way to solve these problems, but the fact of the matter is there simply is no time left.
Finding the Light#062.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#063.src: She must use the extent of her powers, and while she retains her pacifism that will not happen. I must ask you to follow her, as Orphion would wish.
Finding the Light#063.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#064.src: There is, unfortunately, no right to this. There is simply necessity- And there, you must push her to her limits. Seek the cave of the Canned Abis.
Finding the Light#064.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#065.src: It is north-east from here. The entrance is shaded by giant fern leaves. I only pray that this will be enough.
Finding the Light#065.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#066.src: Find the Canned Abis cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Finding the Light#067.src: Find the plant inside the cave.

Finding the Light#069.src: ...I can't believe this. What am I doing wrong? What is it? There has to be some reason, what IS it?!
Finding the Light#069.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#070.src: There's not another inscription...it's just the same words! What does it mean by ‘’dire actions?!‘’ I've done everything I can think of!
Finding the Light#070.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#071.src: Is- Is this not dire enough? Is poring over you and putting aside my role and pride to someone else not EXTREME enough?!
Finding the Light#071.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#072.src: .... I. I have to know. What did Orphion tell you, exactly? I can't stand not knowing any longer. Did he really replace me?
Finding the Light#072.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#073.src: I can't think of any other reason why everything for me has just...stopped working. Did he? Please, tell me-
Finding the Light#073.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#074.src: ...wait... You... You have Canned Abis on you!! Where did you get that?!
Finding the Light#074.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#075.src: You... There's no way you would've known that unless you... YOU! You eavesdropped on me!!
Finding the Light#075.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#076.src: You FOLLOWED ME into the cave even after I asked not to! You... After everything I said!! After you heard all those private thoughts!
Finding the Light#076.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#077.src: You STILL decided it was a good idea to come after me! What are you planning to accomplish like this?!
Finding the Light#077.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#078.src: What, are you thinking ‘’oh, let's follow the funny elf girl and see her FAIL, OVER and OVER AGAIN!?‘’ IS THAT IT?!
Finding the Light#078.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#079.src: You heard me then!! It's ALL out in the open! I can't succeed! You're there! You're doing everything I couldn't!
Finding the Light#079.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#080.src: I'm NOT a failure! I'm not! I won't be! I refuse to be! You don't GET to watch me flounder and flail!!
Finding the Light#080.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#083.src: Wha- I... What just... What did I...?
Finding the Light#083.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#086.src: ...GRAAAAAUGH!! TELL ME HOW THIS IS ‘’ENOUGH!‘’ TELL ME, NOW!
Finding the Light#086.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#087.src: I-I NEARLY KILLED THEM! I JUST BROKE AND DEFILED EVERYTHING I'VE EVER STOOD FOR!!
Finding the Light#087.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#088.src: TELL ME!! HOW COULD THIS POSSIBLY BE THE ANSWER?! HOW COULD THIS BE WHAT NEEDED TO HAPPEN?!
Finding the Light#088.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#089.src: WHY WOULD I BE NEEDED TO... To...
Finding the Light#089.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#090.src: T-Trying to murder them because they did what I couldn't isn't dark? How can you possibly think that?!
Finding the Light#090.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#091.src: What kind of guardian are you, permissing this kind of violence? How is anything I just did alright?
Finding the Light#091.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#092.src: ...you. You can't possibly be saying that what I did was the right thing to do. I refuse to accept that.
Finding the Light#092.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#094.src: ...then... Shouldn't I feel... I don't know. Shouldn't I feel less restrained? Less afraid? More... More free?
Finding the Light#094.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#095.src: If what I've done was what needed to happen, why do I feel like the scum of the earth? Why do I feel so terrible?!
Finding the Light#095.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#096.src: ...I... I need time to process this. I... Do you understand how difficult this is to hear? To bear?
Finding the Light#096.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#097.src: My pulse, your light is brilliant... It has shone upon Lari, and soon her light will shine my way...

Finding the Light#098.src: Enter the roots, and witness the path to my realm. And then, prepare yourself. Muster your most blinding light...
